rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for the skin fold that covers the eye.

example.english: My eyelid often feels heavy when I get up in the morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早起身嗰陣，成日覺得眼皮好重。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 ngaan5 pei4 hou2 cung5

rows.note: Use this formal anatomical term in medical or technical contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The doctor said that my eyelid is slightly inflamed.
example.traditional: 醫生話我嘅眼瞼有少少發炎。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 ngaan5 gim2 jau5 siu2 siu2 faat3 jim4
